description: Cap what you spend through StartupHub per day or per month: on everything, on one listing, or on one label. Calls stop at the limit, and you get an alert when spend passes alert_pct (80% by default). With no arguments, lists your limits and what is spent so far. Set: period plus limit_credits, optionally listing_id or label. Remove: remove_id. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.
name: spend_limits
title: spend limits
